title: Aries learned Libra is its opposite.
caption:
Aries just found out Libra is its opposite. Opposite signs sit across the zodiac wheel, and astrologers read them as mirrors. Fun to explore, but attraction happens between people, not birth dates.
Send this to your opposite sign.
